text: Topik ini menerangkan pengertian sejarah sebagai kajian tentang masa lalu dan bagaimana peristiwa lama membentuk masyarakat hari ini.
text_en: This topic explains the meaning of history as the study of the past and how past events shape society today.

text: Sejarah ialah kajian tentang peristiwa, manusia, dan keadaan pada masa lalu.
text_en: History is the study of events, people, and conditions in the past.

text: Sejarah membantu menjelaskan bagaimana masyarakat berubah dari masa ke masa.
text_en: History helps explain how societies change over time.

text: Pengertian sejarah boleh berbeza tetapi biasanya berkaitan dengan bukti dan interpretasi masa lalu.
text_en: The meaning of history can vary but usually relates to evidence and interpretation of the past.

text: Sejarah melibatkan kajian masa silam untuk memahami masa kini dan masa depan.
text_en: History involves studying the past to understand the present and the future.

text: Kajian sejarah memerlukan sumber seperti dokumen, artifak, dan cerita lisan.
text_en: Historical study requires sources such as documents, artifacts, and oral stories.

text: Apakah maksud sejarah? / What is the meaning of history?
choice_a: Kajian tentang masa lalu dan peristiwa penting. / Study of the past and important events.
choice_b: Kajian tentang masa depan. / Study of the future.
choice_c: Kajian tentang sains sahaja. / Study of science only.
choice_d: Kajian tentang muzik sahaja. / Study of music only.
answer: Kajian tentang masa lalu dan peristiwa penting. / Study of the past and important events.

text: Mengapakah sejarah penting? / Why is history important?
choice_a: Untuk memahami perubahan masyarakat dan identiti bangsa. / To understand social change and national identity.
choice_b: Untuk menonton filem. / To watch movies.
choice_c: Untuk bermain permainan video. / To play video games.
choice_d: Untuk memasak makanan. / To cook food.
answer: Untuk memahami perubahan masyarakat dan identiti bangsa. / To understand social change and national identity.

text: Jelaskan satu sebab mengapa sejarah penting bagi generasi muda. / Explain one reason why history is important for young people.
answer: Sejarah membantu generasi muda belajar daripada kesilapan lalu dan membuat keputusan yang lebih baik untuk masa depan. / History helps young people learn from past mistakes and make better decisions for the future.

text: Topik ini menerangkan bahawa sejarawan memberikan definisi sejarah berdasarkan penemuan bukti, tafsiran, dan perspektif masa lalu.
text_en: This topic explains that historians define history based on evidence, interpretation, and past perspectives.

text: Sejarawan mengkaji dokumen, catatan, dan bukti lain untuk membina pemahaman tentang masa lalu.
text_en: Historians study documents, records, and other evidence to build an understanding of the past.

text: Sejarawan sering menemui dokumen lama, catatan rasmi dan artifak yang membuka maklumat baharu tentang kehidupan masyarakat dahulu.
text_en: Historians often discover old documents, official records, and artifacts that reveal new information about past societies.

text: Penemuan catatan sejarah seperti surat, prasasti atau laporan rasmi membantu ahli sejarah membina semula peristiwa dengan lebih tepat.
text_en: Findings such as letters, inscriptions, or official reports help historians reconstruct events more accurately.

text: Pendekatan sejarawan membantu menjelaskan bagaimana peristiwa dan manusia dikaji secara sistematik.
text_en: A historian's approach helps explain how events and people are studied systematically.

text: Sejarah bukan sekadar cerita, tetapi satu proses analisis bukti untuk membuat kesimpulan.
text_en: History is not just stories, but a process of analyzing evidence to draw conclusions.

text: Ahli sejarah menggunakan sumber primer dan sekunder untuk memahami konteks peristiwa.
text_en: Historians use primary and secondary sources to understand the context of events.

text: Dikenali sebagai bapa sejarah moden kerana konsep 'ilm al-umran' dan analisis sosiologi sejarah, serta meneliti pola perubahan masyarakat.
text_en: Known as the father of modern history for his 'ilm al-umran' concept and sociological analysis of history, as well as studying patterns of social change.

text: Apakah yang digunakan sejarawan untuk mengkaji sejarah? / What do historians use to study history?
choice_a: Dokumen, artifak, dan sumber lisan. / Documents, artifacts, and oral sources.
choice_b: Hanya gambar moden. / Only modern pictures.
choice_c: Hanya filem. / Only movies.
choice_d: Hanya lagu. / Only songs.
answer: Dokumen, artifak, dan sumber lisan. / Documents, artifacts, and oral sources.

text: Mengapa definisi sejarah berbeza antara sejarawan? / Why do definitions of history vary among historians?
choice_a: Kerana setiap sejarawan menggunakan perspektif dan bukti yang berbeza. / Because each historian uses different perspectives and evidence.
choice_b: Kerana sejarah tidak penting. / Because history is not important.
choice_c: Kerana semua orang bergurau. / Because everyone is joking.
choice_d: Kerana ia bergantung pada cuaca. / Because it depends on the weather.
answer: Kerana setiap sejarawan menggunakan perspektif dan bukti yang berbeza. / Because each historian uses different perspectives and evidence.

text: Berikan satu contoh bukti yang boleh mengubah tafsiran sejarah. / Give one example of evidence that can change historical interpretation.
answer: Penemuan dokumen baru atau artifak arkeologi boleh mengubah cara sejarawan mentafsir peristiwa lalu. / The discovery of a new document or archaeological artifact can change how historians interpret past events.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Topik ini menerangkan konsep masa dan ruang dalam sejarah, iaitu bagaimana peristiwa berlaku dalam konteks waktu dan tempat tertentu.
text_en: This topic explains the concepts of time and space in history, meaning how events occur within a specific time and place.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Masa merujuk kepada jangka waktu di mana peristiwa berlaku.
text_en: Time refers to the period during which events happen.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Ruang merujuk kepada lokasi atau tempat di mana peristiwa berlaku.
text_en: Space refers to the location or place where events occur.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Analisis sejarah memerlukan pemahaman tentang hubungan antara masa dan ruang.
text_en: Historical analysis requires understanding the relationship between time and space.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Sejarah boleh menunjukkan perubahan dalam masyarakat pada waktu dan tempat tertentu.
text_en: History can show changes in society at particular times and places.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Peristiwa sejarah mesti ditempatkan dalam konteks masa dan ruang yang betul.
text_en: Historical events must be placed in the correct time and space context.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Apakah maksud ruang dalam sejarah? / What does space mean in history?
choice_a: Tempat atau lokasi di mana peristiwa berlaku. / The place or location where events occur.
choice_b: Masa yang lalu. / The past time.
choice_c: Alat muzik. / Musical instruments.
choice_d: Jenis makanan. / Types of food.
answer: Tempat atau lokasi di mana peristiwa berlaku. / The place or location where events occur.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Apakah yang ditunjukkan oleh konsep masa dalam sejarah? / What does the concept of time in history show?
choice_a: Perubahan dalam masyarakat dan peristiwa sepanjang tempoh tertentu. / Changes in society and events over a certain period.
choice_b: Jenis pakaian sahaja. / Only types of clothing.
choice_c: Tumbuhan sahaja. / Only plants.
choice_d: Haiwan sahaja. / Only animals.
answer: Perubahan dalam masyarakat dan peristiwa sepanjang tempoh tertentu. / Changes in society and events over a certain period.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Nyatakan maksud ruang dalam sejarah dalam satu ayat. / State the meaning of space in history in one sentence.
answer: Ruang dalam sejarah merujuk kepada lokasi atau tempat di mana peristiwa berlaku. / Space in history refers to the location or place where events occur.

text: Topik ini membincangkan jenis sumber sejarah seperti sumber bertulis, lisan, dan artifak yang membantu kita memahami masa lalu.
text_en: This topic discusses types of historical sources such as written, oral, and artifact sources that help us understand the past.

text: Sumber sejarah adalah bahan yang memberi maklumat tentang masa lalu.
text_en: Historical sources are materials that provide information about the past.

text: Sumber primer ialah bahan asal yang dibuat semasa peristiwa berlaku, seperti dokumen rasmi, surat, atau artifak.
text_en: Primary sources are original materials created during the event, such as official documents, letters, or artifacts.

text: Sumber sekunder ialah kajian atau ulasan tentang masa lalu yang ditulis kemudian, seperti buku sejarah dan artikel.
text_en: Secondary sources are studies or reviews of the past written later, such as history books or articles.

text: Sumber bertulis, lisan, dan artifak boleh menjadi primer atau sekunder bergantung pada bagaimana ia digunakan.
text_en: Written, oral, and artifact sources can be primary or secondary depending on how they are used.

text: Ahli sejarah mengutamakan sumber primer untuk bukti langsung dan menggunakan sumber sekunder untuk konteks dan tafsiran.
text_en: Historians prioritize primary sources for direct evidence and use secondary sources for context and interpretation.

text: Dikenali sebagai bapa sejarah Barat kerana menulis tentang Perang Parsi dan mengumpul sumber dari banyak tempat.
text_en: Known as the father of Western history for writing about the Persian Wars and collecting sources from many places.

text: Apakah contoh sumber lisan? / What is an example of an oral source?
choice_a: Wawancara dan cerita rakyat. / Interviews and folk tales.
choice_b: Gambar moden. / Modern pictures.
choice_c: Surat rasmi. / Official letters.
choice_d: Basikal. / Bicycle.
answer: Wawancara dan cerita rakyat. / Interviews and folk tales.

text: Mengapakah artifak penting sebagai sumber sejarah? / Why are artifacts important as historical sources?
choice_a: Kerana ia menunjukkan cara hidup dan budaya masyarakat dahulu. / Because it shows how people lived and their culture.
choice_b: Kerana ia membuat makanan. / Because it makes food.
choice_c: Kerana ia menari. / Because it dances.
choice_d: Kerana ia mengajar sains. / Because it teaches science.
answer: Kerana ia menunjukkan cara hidup dan budaya masyarakat dahulu. / Because it shows how people lived and their culture.

text: Apakah perbezaan utama antara sumber bertulis dan sumber lisan? / What is the main difference between written sources and oral sources?
answer: Sumber bertulis direkodkan dalam bentuk dokumen, manakala sumber lisan disampaikan melalui cerita atau ucapan. / Written sources are recorded in documents, while oral sources are delivered through stories or speech.

text: Topik ini menjelaskan kaedah penyelidikan sejarah seperti kaedah bertulis, kaedah lisan, dan kaedah arkeologi untuk mengumpulkan maklumat tentang masa lalu.
text_en: This topic explains historical research methods like written, oral, and archaeological methods for gathering information about the past.

text: Penyelidikan sejarah menggunakan dokumen bertulis untuk mencari bukti masa lalu.
text_en: Historical research uses written documents to find evidence of the past.

text: Kaedah lisan melibatkan wawancara dan cerita tradisi.
text_en: Oral methods involve interviews and traditional stories.

text: Kaedah arkeologi menganalisis artifak dan struktur yang ditemui.
text_en: Archaeological methods analyze artifacts and structures that are found.

text: Gabungan beberapa kaedah membantu menghasilkan kajian sejarah yang lebih lengkap.
text_en: Combining several methods helps produce more complete historical research.

text: Penyelidikan sejarah memerlukan ketelitian dalam menilai kesahihan sumber.
text_en: Historical research requires care in assessing the validity of sources.

text: Apakah kaedah penyelidikan yang menggunakan artifak? / Which research method uses artifacts?
choice_a: Kaedah arkeologi. / Archaeological method.
choice_b: Kaedah lisan. / Oral method.
choice_c: Kaedah bertulis. / Written method.
choice_d: Kaedah sains. / Science method.
answer: Kaedah arkeologi. / Archaeological method.

text: Apakah tujuan kaedah bertulis dalam sejarah? / What is the purpose of written methods in history?
choice_a: Untuk menggunakan dokumen dan rekod sebagai bukti. / To use documents and records as evidence.
choice_b: Untuk bermain permainan. / To play games.
choice_c: Untuk menyanyi. / To sing.
choice_d: Untuk melukis. / To paint.
answer: Untuk menggunakan dokumen dan rekod sebagai bukti. / To use documents and records as evidence.

text: Mengapa kaedah arkeologi penting dalam penyelidikan sejarah? / Why is the archaeological method important in historical research?
answer: Kerana ia membolehkan ahli sejarah menemui bukti fizikal daripada masa lalu yang tidak terdapat dalam dokumen bertulis. / Because it allows historians to find physical evidence from the past that is not available in written documents.

text: Topik ini menerangkan bentuk fizikal Bumi, kawasan daratan, lautan, dan bagaimana alam sekitar membentuk kehidupan manusia.
text_en: This topic explains the physical form of Earth, land areas, seas, and how the environment shapes human life.

text: Bumi terdiri daripada kawasan daratan, lautan, gunung, dan kawasan sejuk.
text_en: Earth consists of land, oceans, mountains, and cold regions.

text: Pembentukan fizikal Bumi mempengaruhi taburan haiwan, tumbuhan, dan manusia.
text_en: Earth's physical formation affects the distribution of animals, plants, and humans.

text: Lautan dan daratan menjadi penanda arah pergerakan manusia dan perdagangan.
text_en: Oceans and land became routes for movement and trade.

text: Perubahan bentuk muka bumi menghasilkan perbezaan iklim dan sumber makanan.
text_en: Changes in the landscape created differences in climate and food sources.

text: Pengetahuan tentang dunia membantu kita memahami perubahan alam sekitar.
text_en: Knowledge about the world helps us understand environmental change.

text: Apakah dua unsur utama yang membentuk permukaan Bumi? / What are the two main elements that shape the surface of Earth?
choice_a: Daratan dan lautan. / Land and oceans.
choice_b: Awan dan hujan. / Clouds and rain.
choice_c: Rumah dan jalan raya. / Houses and roads.
choice_d: Kertas dan pensel. / Paper and pencils.
answer: Daratan dan lautan. / Land and oceans.

text: Mengapakah bentuk fizikal Bumi penting dalam sejarah? / Why is the physical form of Earth important in history?
choice_a: Kerana ia mempengaruhi kehidupan manusia dan taburan sumber. / Because it affects human life and resource distribution.
choice_b: Kerana ia melibatkan permainan komputer. / Because it involves computer games.
choice_c: Kerana ia hanya untuk ilmu geografi moden. / Because it is only for modern geography.
choice_d: Kerana ia tidak memberi kesan apa-apa. / Because it has no effect.
answer: Kerana ia mempengaruhi kehidupan manusia dan taburan sumber. / Because it affects human life and resource distribution.

text: Nyatakan satu sebab mengapa lautan penting dalam kehidupan manusia. / State one reason why oceans are important to human life.
answer: Lautan menyediakan laluan pergerakan, sumber makanan, dan penghubung antara kawasan. / Oceans provide routes of movement, food sources, and links between regions.

text: Topik ini menerangkan konsep zaman air batu, iaitu tempoh ketika suhu Bumi menjadi lebih sejuk dan kawasan besar dilitupi ais.
text_en: This topic explains the concept of the Ice Age, a period when Earth's temperature became colder and large areas were covered by ice.

text: Zaman air batu ialah tempoh cuaca sejuk yang meliputi kawasan besar di Bumi.
text_en: The Ice Age was a period of cold weather that covered large areas of Earth.

text: Semasa zaman air batu, banyak kawasan yang kini panas menjadi sejuk dan dilitupi ais.
text_en: During the Ice Age, many areas that are now warm became cold and covered with ice.

text: Kitaran perubahan suhu menyebabkan zon ais berkembang dan surut secara berulang.
text_en: Cycles of temperature change caused ice zones to expand and shrink repeatedly.

text: Perubahan suhu ini memberi kesan besar kepada tumbuhan, haiwan, dan manusia.
text_en: These temperature changes had major effects on plants, animals, and humans.

text: Zaman air batu membentuk landskap, sungai, dan bentuk muka bumi yang kita lihat hari ini.
text_en: The Ice Age shaped landscapes, rivers, and landforms that we see today.

text: Apakah yang dimaksudkan dengan zaman air batu? / What is meant by the Ice Age?
choice_a: Tempoh cuaca sejuk yang meliputi kawasan besar. / A period of cold weather covering large areas.
choice_b: Tempoh cuaca panas yang berterusan. / A continuous hot weather period.
choice_c: Tempoh hujan yang sangat lebat. / A period of very heavy rain.
choice_d: Tempoh banjir besar. / A period of major flooding.
answer: Tempoh cuaca sejuk yang meliputi kawasan besar. / A period of cold weather covering large areas.

text: Mengapakah zaman air batu penting dalam sejarah alam sekitar? / Why is the Ice Age important in environmental history?
choice_a: Kerana ia mengubah landskap dan taburan hidupan. / Because it changed landscapes and the distribution of life.
choice_b: Kerana ia membina bangunan moden. / Because it built modern buildings.
choice_c: Kerana ia menghasilkan elektrik. / Because it produced electricity.
choice_d: Kerana ia tidak memberi kesan. / Because it had no impact.
answer: Kerana ia mengubah landskap dan taburan hidupan. / Because it changed landscapes and the distribution of life.

text: Nyatakan satu kesan zaman air batu terhadap alam sekitar. / State one effect of the Ice Age on the environment.
answer: Ia menyebabkan kawasan besar dilitupi ais dan mengubah bentuk muka bumi. / It caused large areas to be covered with ice and changed the landforms.

text: Topik ini menerangkan garis masa zaman air batu dan perubahan suhu yang berlaku secara berperingkat.
text_en: This topic explains the timeline of the Ice Age and the gradual changes in temperature that took place.

text: Garis masa menunjukkan perubahan suhu dari masa ke masa.
text_en: The timeline shows changes in temperature over time.

text: Pada tahap tertentu, suhu menurun lalu ais berkembang di kawasan tertentu.
text_en: At certain points, temperatures dropped and ice expanded in some regions.

text: Pada tahap lain, suhu meningkat lalu ais mula surut.
text_en: At other points, temperatures rose and ice began to retreat.

text: Perubahan ini berlaku berulang dan mengambil masa yang sangat lama.
text_en: These changes occurred repeatedly over a very long period.

text: Garis masa membantu kita memahami urutan perubahan geografi dan iklim.
text_en: The timeline helps us understand the sequence of geographic and climatic changes.

text: Mengapakah garis masa penting dalam mempelajari zaman air batu? / Why is a timeline important in studying the Ice Age?
choice_a: Kerana ia membantu melihat urutan perubahan secara berperingkat. / Because it helps show the sequence of changes step by step.
choice_b: Kerana ia hanya menunjukkan tarikh moden. / Because it only shows modern dates.
choice_c: Kerana ia tidak mempunyai kaitan. / Because it is irrelevant.
choice_d: Kerana ia hanya untuk matematik. / Because it is only for mathematics.
answer: Kerana ia membantu melihat urutan perubahan secara berperingkat. / Because it helps show the sequence of changes step by step.

text: Apakah yang berlaku apabila suhu menurun? / What happens when temperatures drop?
choice_a: Ais berkembang di kawasan tertentu. / Ice expands in some areas.
choice_b: Lautan menjadi kering sepenuhnya. / The oceans dry up completely.
choice_c: Semua kawasan menjadi panas. / All regions become hot.
choice_d: Hutan tumbuh dengan cepat. / Forests grow quickly.
answer: Ais berkembang di kawasan tertentu. / Ice expands in some areas.

text: Nyatakan satu perubahan yang dapat dilihat dalam garis masa zaman air batu. / State one change that can be seen in the Ice Age timeline.
answer: Suhu berubah secara berulang dan menyebabkan ais berkembang serta surut. / Temperature changed repeatedly and caused ice to expand and retreat.

text: Topik ini membincangkan ciri-ciri utama zaman air batu akhir, termasuk kawasan ais, tumbuhan sejuk, dan perubahan cuaca yang ketara.
text_en: This topic discusses the main features of the late Ice Age, including ice-covered areas, cold plants, and significant weather changes.

text: Zaman air batu akhir ditandai dengan kawasan ais yang luas dan suhu yang sangat sejuk.
text_en: The late Ice Age was marked by vast ice-covered regions and very cold temperatures.

text: Tumbuhan yang tahan sejuk lebih dominan di kawasan tertentu.
text_en: Cold-tolerant plants became more dominant in some areas.

text: Haiwan seperti mamalia besar dapat bertahan di kawasan sejuk.
text_en: Animals such as large mammals could survive in cold regions.

text: Bentuk muka bumi berubah akibat hakisan dan pemendapan ais.
text_en: The landscape changed due to erosion and deposition by ice.

text: Kawasan yang kini subur mungkin berubah menjadi tundra atau padang sejuk.
text_en: Areas that are now fertile may have become tundra or cold grasslands.

text: Apakah ciri utama zaman air batu akhir? / What was a main feature of the late Ice Age?
choice_a: Suhu yang sangat sejuk dan kawasan ais yang luas. / Very cold temperatures and extensive ice coverage.
choice_b: Suhu panas sepanjang masa. / Constant hot temperatures.
choice_c: Lautan yang sangat kecil. / Very small oceans.
choice_d: Hutan tropika yang sangat tebal. / Very thick tropical forests.
answer: Suhu yang sangat sejuk dan kawasan ais yang luas. / Very cold temperatures and extensive ice coverage.

text: Mengapakah tumbuhan sejuk penting semasa zaman air batu akhir? / Why were cold plants important during the late Ice Age?
choice_a: Kerana ia membantu menyesuaikan ekosistem dengan cuaca sejuk. / Because they helped ecosystems adapt to cold weather.
choice_b: Kerana ia menghalang semua haiwan hidup. / Because they prevented all animals from living.
choice_c: Kerana ia menjadikan kawasan lebih panas. / Because they made areas hotter.
choice_d: Kerana ia tidak mempunyai sebarang fungsi. / Because they had no function.
answer: Kerana ia membantu menyesuaikan ekosistem dengan cuaca sejuk. / Because they helped ecosystems adapt to cold weather.

text: Nyatakan satu ciri tumbuhan atau haiwan semasa zaman air batu akhir. / State one feature of plants or animals during the late Ice Age.
answer: Tumbuhan dan haiwan yang tahan sejuk lebih dominan dan dapat bertahan dalam iklim sejuk. / Cold-tolerant plants and animals were more dominant and able to survive in cold climates.

text: Topik ini menerangkan perubahan bentuk muka bumi dan paras laut akibat penyejukan dan pencairan ais.
text_en: This topic explains changes in landforms and sea level caused by cooling and melting ice.

text: Perubahan iklim menyebabkan paras laut berubah dari masa ke masa.
text_en: Climate change caused sea levels to change over time.

text: Penyejukan menyebabkan laut berkurang dan kawasan daratan terdedah.
text_en: Cooling caused the sea to shrink and exposed more land.

text: Pencairan ais pula meningkatkan paras laut dan mengubah pantai.
text_en: Melting ice raised sea levels and changed coastlines.

text: Perubahan ini mempengaruhi habitat manusia dan haiwan.
text_en: These changes affected the habitats of humans and animals.

text: Landskap yang berubah membentuk laluan baru untuk pergerakan manusia.
text_en: The changing landscape created new routes for human movement.

text: Apakah yang berlaku apabila ais mencair? / What happens when ice melts?
choice_a: Paras laut meningkat. / Sea levels rise.
choice_b: Semua kawasan menjadi beku. / All areas become frozen.
choice_c: Hutan hilang sepenuhnya. / Forests disappear completely.
choice_d: Tiada perubahan berlaku. / No change occurs.
answer: Paras laut meningkat. / Sea levels rise.

text: Mengapakah perubahan paras laut penting kepada manusia? / Why are changes in sea level important to humans?
choice_a: Kerana ia mengubah kawasan penempatan dan sumber makanan. / Because it changes settlement areas and food sources.
choice_b: Kerana ia hanya menjejaskan haiwan laut. / Because it only affects marine animals.
choice_c: Kerana ia membuat cuaca lebih sejuk. / Because it makes the weather colder.
choice_d: Kerana ia mencipta mesin moden. / Because it creates modern machines.
answer: Kerana ia mengubah kawasan penempatan dan sumber makanan. / Because it changes settlement areas and food sources.

text: Nyatakan satu kesan pencairan ais terhadap alam sekitar. / State one effect of ice melting on the environment.
answer: Pencairan ais meningkatkan paras laut dan mengubah garis pantai. / Melting ice raises sea levels and changes coastlines.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Topik ini menerangkan kesan perubahan zaman air batu terhadap Asia Tenggara, termasuk kawasan daratan yang terdedah dan perubahan ekosistem.
text_en: This topic explains the effects of Ice Age changes in Southeast Asia, including exposed land areas and ecosystem changes.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Perubahan zaman air batu mempengaruhi Asia Tenggara melalui perubahan paras laut dan bentuk muka bumi.
text_en: Ice Age changes affected Southeast Asia through changes in sea level and landforms.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Kawasan daratan yang terdedah membolehkan pergerakan haiwan dan manusia ke kawasan yang berbeza.
text_en: Exposed land areas allowed animals and humans to move to different places.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Ekosistem berubah apabila kawasan sejuk menggantikan kawasan tropika tertentu.
text_en: Ecosystems changed when cold regions replaced some tropical areas.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Perubahan ini mempengaruhi taburan tumbuhan, haiwan, dan masyarakat awal.
text_en: These changes affected the distribution of plants, animals, and early communities.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Kesan zaman air batu masih dapat dilihat dalam bentuk landskap dan taburan sumber.
text_en: The effects of the Ice Age can still be seen in the landscape and distribution of resources.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Mengapakah Asia Tenggara terjejas oleh perubahan zaman air batu? / Why was Southeast Asia affected by changes during the Ice Age?
choice_a: Kerana perubahan paras laut dan bentuk muka bumi mempengaruhi kawasan ini. / Because changes in sea level and landforms affected the region.
choice_b: Kerana tiada haiwan hidup di kawasan ini. / Because no animals lived in the region.
choice_c: Kerana cuaca sentiasa panas. / Because the weather was always hot.
choice_d: Kerana laut menghilang sepenuhnya. / Because the sea disappeared completely.
answer: Kerana perubahan paras laut dan bentuk muka bumi mempengaruhi kawasan ini. / Because changes in sea level and landforms affected the region.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Apakah kesan perubahan zaman air batu terhadap ekosistem Asia Tenggara? / What effect did Ice Age changes have on Southeast Asian ecosystems?
choice_a: Ekosistem berubah dan taburan hidupan berubah. / Ecosystems changed and the distribution of life changed.
choice_b: Semua hutan musnah sepenuhnya. / All forests were completely destroyed.
choice_c: Tiada perubahan berlaku. / No change occurred.
choice_d: Semua laut menjadi beku. / All oceans became frozen.
answer: Ekosistem berubah dan taburan hidupan berubah. / Ecosystems changed and the distribution of life changed.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Nyatakan satu kesan perubahan zaman air batu terhadap Asia Tenggara. / State one effect of Ice Age changes on Southeast Asia.
answer: Ia mengubah paras laut, landskap, dan taburan manusia serta hidupan. / It changed sea level, landscapes, and the distribution of humans and life.

text: Topik ini menerangkan maksud zaman prasejarah, pembahagian zaman batu dan zaman logam, serta perkembangan teknologi dan kehidupan manusia awal.
text_en: This topic explains the meaning of the prehistoric age, the division between the Stone Age and Metal Age, and the development of technology and early human life.

text: Zaman prasejarah ialah zaman sebelum manusia mengenal tulisan.
text_en: The prehistoric age is the period before humans knew writing.

text: Zaman ini terbahagi kepada Zaman Batu dan Zaman Logam.
text_en: It is divided into the Stone Age and the Metal Age.

text: Zaman Paleolitik menekankan teknologi batu ringkas dan kehidupan nomad.
text_en: The Palaeolithic Age emphasized simple stone technology and nomadic life.

text: Zaman Mesolitik menonjolkan pemburuan binatang dan penangkapan ikan.
text_en: The Mesolithic Age highlighted animal hunting and fishing.

text: Zaman Neolitik memperlihatkan petempatan menetap, pertanian, penternakan, dan tembikar.
text_en: The Neolithic Age saw settled settlements, farming, animal husbandry, and pottery.

text: Zaman Logam melibatkan inovasi gangsa dan besi, pelayaran, dan perdagangan barter.
text_en: The Metal Age involved bronze and iron innovations, seafaring, and barter trade.

text: Apakah maksud zaman prasejarah? / What is the meaning of the prehistoric age?
choice_a: Zaman sebelum manusia mengenali tulisan. / The age before humans knew writing.
choice_b: Zaman selepas penciptaan roda. / The age after the invention of the wheel.
choice_c: Zaman manusia mula menggunakan besi. / The age when humans started using iron.
choice_d: Zaman manusia membina bandar besar. / The age when humans built large cities.
answer: Zaman sebelum manusia mengenali tulisan. / The age before humans knew writing.

text: Apakah urutan yang betul bagi perkembangan Zaman Batu? / What is the correct sequence of the Stone Age development?
choice_a: Mesolitik -> Paleolitik -> Neolitik / Mesolithic -> Palaeolithic -> Neolithic
choice_b: Neolitik -> Mesolitik -> Paleolitik / Neolithic -> Mesolithic -> Palaeolithic
choice_c: Paleolitik -> Mesolitik -> Neolitik / Palaeolithic -> Mesolithic -> Neolithic
choice_d: Paleolitik -> Neolitik -> Mesolitik / Palaeolithic -> Neolithic -> Mesolithic
answer: Paleolitik -> Mesolitik -> Neolitik / Palaeolithic -> Mesolithic -> Neolithic

text: Terangkan dua perbezaan utama antara Zaman Paleolitik dan Zaman Neolitik. / Explain two main differences between the Palaeolithic and Neolithic Ages.
answer: Pada Zaman Paleolitik, manusia menggunakan peralatan batu kasar dan hidup secara nomad; pada Zaman Neolitik, mereka menggunakan alat batu yang lebih halus dan mula hidup menetap serta bercucuk tanam. / In the Palaeolithic Age, humans used rough stone tools and lived a nomadic life; in the Neolithic Age, they used finer tools and began living in settled communities and farming.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Topik ini menerangkan lokasi tapak prasejarah di dunia dan Asia Tenggara, termasuk bukti penemuan artifak dan ekofak.
text_en: This topic explains the locations of prehistoric sites in the world and Southeast Asia, including evidence of artifacts and ecofacts.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Tapak prasejarah dikesan melalui penemuan artifak dan ekofak di kawasan terbuka atau gua.
text_en: Prehistoric sites are identified through artifacts and ecofacts found in open areas or caves.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Contoh tapak dunia termasuk Altamira, Chauvet Cave, Catal Huyuk, Stonehenge, Bhimbetka, Zhoukoudian, Shahr-i-Sokhta, dan Gobekli Tepe.
text_en: Examples of world sites include Altamira, Chauvet Cave, Catal Huyuk, Stonehenge, Bhimbetka, Zhoukoudian, Shahr-i-Sokhta, and Gobekli Tepe.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Contoh tapak di Asia Tenggara termasuk Lenggong, Ban Chiang, Liang Bua Cave, Padah-lin Cave, Sa Hyun, dan Tabon Cave.
text_en: Examples in Southeast Asia include Lenggong, Ban Chiang, Liang Bua Cave, Padah-lin Cave, Sa Hyun, and Tabon Cave.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Penemuan tapak prasejarah membantu ahli arkeologi memahami petempatan, penguburan, dan peralatan masyarakat awal.
text_en: Discoveries of prehistoric sites help archaeologists understand settlements, burials, and the tools of early societies.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Tapak-tapak ini menjadi bukti penting tentang kehidupan manusia sebelum kemunculan tulisan.
text_en: These sites are important evidence of human life before the advent of writing.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Rangka manusia 'Peking Man' ditemui di tapak prasejarah manakah? / The human skeleton 'Peking Man' was discovered at which prehistoric site?
choice_a: Catal Huyuk, Turkey
choice_b: Zhoukoudian, China
choice_c: Bhimbetka, India
choice_d: Altamira, Spain
answer: Zhoukoudian, China

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Gua Liang Bua di Flores, Indonesia terkenal dengan penemuan fosil apa? / Liang Bua Cave in Flores, Indonesia is famous for the discovery of which fossil?
choice_a: Perak Man
choice_b: Peking Man
choice_c: Flores Man (Homo Floresiensis)
choice_d: Java Man
answer: Flores Man (Homo Floresiensis)

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Nyatakan fungsi penemuan tapak zaman prasejarah kepada ahli arkeologi. / State the function of discovering prehistoric sites to archaeologists.
answer: Tapak prasejarah berfungsi sebagai bukti petempatan, kawasan perkuburan, kawasan perburuan, dan tempat pembuatan peralatan batu atau ritual masyarakat prasejarah. / Prehistoric sites serve as evidence of settlements, burial grounds, hunting areas, and manufacturing sites for stone tools or rituals of prehistoric societies.

text: Topik ini menerangkan ciri kehidupan manusia prasejarah dari segi kediaman, ekonomi, kepercayaan, dan kesenian.
text_en: This topic explains the characteristics of prehistoric human life in terms of dwellings, economy, beliefs, and art.

text: Kediaman manusia berubah daripada gua dan ranting kepada rumah tetap batu atau kayu.
text_en: Human dwellings changed from caves and branches to permanent stone or wooden houses.

text: Ekonomi berubah daripada sara diri dan nomad kepada pertanian, penternakan, dan sistem barter.
text_en: Economies shifted from subsistence and nomadic life to agriculture, animal husbandry, and barter systems.

text: Kepercayaan berkembang daripada animisme kepada ritual, penyembahan alam, dan kepercayaan kepada kehidupan selepas mati.
text_en: Beliefs evolved from animism to rituals, nature worship, and belief in life after death.

text: Seni pula berkembang daripada lukisan gua realistik kepada corak simbolik dan geometri pada tembikar serta gendang gangsa.
text_en: Art evolved from realistic cave paintings to symbolic and geometric designs on pottery and bronze drums.

text: Organisasi sosial mula menjadi lebih teratur dengan pembahagian peranan dan kelas.
text_en: Social organization became more structured with role and class divisions.

text: Apakah bentuk kepercayaan manusia Zaman Paleolitik? / What was the form of belief system of Palaeolithic humans?
choice_a: Menyembah berhala / Idolatry
choice_b: Animisme / Animism
choice_c: Monoteisme / Monotheism
choice_d: Keagamaan tersusun / Organized religion
answer: Animisme / Animism

text: Apakah keistimewaan seni pada Zaman Neolitik? / What was the artistic highlight during the Neolithic Age?
choice_a: Pola geometri pada tembikar / Geometric patterns on pottery
choice_b: Ukiran gangsa / Bronze carving
choice_c: Lukisan gua realisme / Realism cave painting
choice_d: Patung ukiran batu besar / Megalithic statue carvings
answer: Pola geometri pada tembikar / Geometric patterns on pottery

text: Mengapakah pembahagian kelas sosial mula wujud pada Zaman Neolitik? / Why did social class divisions begin during the Neolithic Age?
answer: Kerana manusia mula hidup menetap dan membentuk sistem sosial yang lebih teratur. / Because humans began living in settled communities and forming a more organized social system.

text: Topik ini menerangkan bagaimana aktiviti prasejarah diteruskan dan dipertingkat dalam masyarakat moden hari ini.
text_en: This topic explains how prehistoric activities continued and improved in modern society today.

text: Aktiviti pertanian dan penternakan berkembang daripada sara diri kepada industri komersial besar-besaran.
text_en: Agriculture and livestock activities evolved from subsistence to large-scale commercial industries.

text: Aktiviti memburu binatang berubah daripada keperluan hidup kepada hobi berlesen.
text_en: Animal hunting changed from a survival necessity to a licensed hobby.

text: Peralatan dan tembikar berkembang daripada batu dan tulang kepada mesin moden dan industri penting.
text_en: Tools and pottery evolved from stone and bone to modern machinery and important industries.

text: Amalan menghormati orang mati dan seni bina megalitik terus memberi inspirasi kepada masyarakat moden.
text_en: Practices of honoring the dead and megalithic architecture continue to inspire modern societies.

text: Sumbangan prasejarah masih dapat dilihat dalam kehidupan seharian moden.
text_en: Prehistoric contributions are still visible in everyday modern life.

text: Bagaimanakah aktiviti memburu binatang dijalankan pada zaman moden kini? / How is animal hunting carried out in modern times today?
choice_a: Dijalankan untuk sara diri sahaja / Carried out solely for subsistence
choice_b: Dijalankan sebagai hobi dengan lesen berdaftar / Carried out as a hobby with a registered license
choice_c: Menggunakan perangkap batu kasar / Using rough stone traps
choice_d: Dilarang sepenuhnya di seluruh dunia / Strictly prohibited worldwide
answer: Dijalankan sebagai hobi dengan lesen berdaftar / Carried out as a hobby with a registered license

text: Apakah contoh industri tembikar warisan prasejarah yang terkenal di Kuala Kangsar, Perak? / What is a famous example of a prehistoric heritage pottery industry in Kuala Kangsar, Perak?
choice_a: Gendang Gangsa / Bronze Drum
choice_b: Tembikar Dinasti Ming / Ming Dynasty Pottery
choice_c: Labu Sayong / Labu Sayong
choice_d: Pasu Terracotta / Terracotta Vase
answer: Labu Sayong / Labu Sayong

text: Nyatakan dua contoh aktiviti zaman prasejarah yang masih diamalkan dalam masyarakat moden. / State two examples of prehistoric activities still practiced in modern society.
answer: Aktiviti pertanian dan penternakan, serta pembuatan tembikar. / Agricultural and livestock activities, as well as pottery making.

text: Topik ini menerangkan perkembangan zaman prasejarah di Malaysia dari Paleolitik hingga Logam, beserta bukti arkeologi yang ditemui.
text_en: This topic explains the development of the prehistoric age in Malaysia from the Palaeolithic to the Metal Age, along with archaeological evidence found.

text: Malaysia meliputi Zaman Paleolitik, Hoabinhian/Epi-Paleolitik, Neolitik, dan Logam.
text_en: Malaysia covered the Palaeolithic, Hoabinhian/Epi-Palaeolithic, Neolithic, and Metal Ages.

text: Bukti kewujudan prasejarah di Malaysia termasuk peralatan batu dan logam, tembikar, manik, lukisan gua, ukiran batu, dan budaya megalit.
text_en: Evidence of prehistoric life in Malaysia includes stone and metal tools, pottery, beads, cave paintings, stone carvings, and megalithic culture.

text: Contoh tapak penting termasuk Kota Tampan, Gua Niah, Tingkayu, Gua Cha, Jenderam Hilir, Gua Kecil, Lubang Angin, Lembah Bernam, dan Sungai Tembeling.
text_en: Important sites include Kota Tampan, Niah Cave, Tingkayu, Gua Cha, Jenderam Hilir, Gua Kecil, Lubang Angin, Bernam Valley, and Sungai Tembeling.

text: Kaedah pengebumian prasejarah di Malaysia termasuk pengebumian memanjang, melentur, keranda kayu, tempayan, dan kubur kepingan batu.
text_en: Burial methods included extended burial, flexed burial, wooden coffins, jar burial, and stone-slab graves.

text: Penemuan di Malaysia menunjukkan masyarakat prasejarah sudah mempunyai kemampuan ekonomi, sosial, dan kepercayaan yang kompleks.
text_en: Findings in Malaysia show prehistoric communities already had complex economic, social, and belief systems.

text: Rangka 'Perak Man' yang berusia 11,000 hingga 10,000 SM ditemui di kawasan mana? / The 'Perak Man' skeleton dating back 11,000 to 10,000 BC was found in which area?
choice_a: Gua Niah, Sarawak
choice_b: Lenggong, Perak
choice_c: Tingkayu, Sabah
choice_d: Jenderam Hilir, Selangor
answer: Lenggong, Perak

text: Apakah nama alat batu khas yang digunakan untuk menuai padi pada Zaman Neolitik di Pahang? / What is the special stone tool used for harvesting rice during the Neolithic Age in Pahang?
choice_a: Mikrolit / Microlith
choice_b: Pisau Tembeling / Tembeling Knife
choice_c: Kapak Bersoket / Socketed Axe
choice_d: Tulang Mawas / Ape Bone Tool
answer: Pisau Tembeling / Tembeling Knife

text: Berikan dua bukti arkeologi yang menunjukkan kewujudan zaman prasejarah di Malaysia. / Provide two archaeological evidences showing the existence of the prehistoric age in Malaysia.
answer: Penemuan peralatan batu/logam seperti di Kota Tampan dan penemuan lukisan gua serta tembikar seperti di Gua Niah. / Discovery of stone/metal tools such as in Kota Tampan and discovery of cave paintings and pottery such as in Niah Cave.

text: Topik ini menerangkan maksud tamadun dari sudut bahasa Yunani, Arab, Inggeris, dan Melayu, serta hubungannya dengan kemajuan masyarakat.
text_en: This topic explains the meaning of civilisation from Greek, Arabic, English, and Malay perspectives, as well as its relationship to societal progress.

text: Perkataan civitas dalam bahasa Yunani membawa maksud bandar atau kota.
text_en: The word civitas in Greek means town or city.

text: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, civilisation merujuk kepada peringkat perkembangan manusia dan organisasi yang dianggap maju.
text_en: In English, civilisation refers to the level of human and organizational development regarded as advanced.

text: Dalam bahasa Arab, istilah seperti mudun, madain, madana, hadharah, dan hadari berkaitan dengan bandar, kekayaan, dan kehidupan yang tersusun.
text_en: In Arabic, terms such as mudun, madain, madana, hadharah, and hadari are related to cities, wealth, and organized life.

text: Dalam bahasa Melayu, tamadun sering dikaitkan dengan perkataan peradaban yang merujuk kepada kemajuan dalam kebendaan dan pemikiran.
text_en: In Malay, civilisation is often associated with the word peradaban, meaning progress in material life and thought.

text: Tamadun melibatkan perkembangan budaya, sains, industri, ekonomi, dan sistem kerajaan.
text_en: Civilisation involves the development of culture, science, industry, economy, and government systems.

text: Perkataan 'Civitas' dalam bahasa Yunani membawa maksud... / The word 'Civitas' in Greek means...
choice_a: Bandar atau kota / Town or city
choice_b: Perkembangan rohani / Spiritual development
choice_c: Kepercayaan tempatan / Local belief
choice_d: Sistem pertanian / Agricultural system
answer: Bandar atau kota / Town or city

text: Istilah bahasa Arab yang merujuk kepada kawasan atau bandar yang digunakan untuk bertani ialah... / The Arabic term referring to a region or city used for farming is...
choice_a: Madana
choice_b: Mudun
choice_c: Hadharah
choice_d: Peradaban
answer: Hadharah

text: Nyatakan satu maksud tamadun dalam bahasa Melayu. / State one meaning of civilisation in Malay.
answer: Dalam bahasa Melayu, tamadun dikaitkan dengan peradaban yang merujuk kepada kemajuan dalam kebendaan dan pemikiran. / In Malay, civilisation is associated with peradaban, meaning progress in material life and thought.

text: Topik ini membandingkan konsep tamadun menurut pandangan Islam dan Barat, termasuk fokus pembangunan lahiriah dan rohaniah.
text_en: This topic compares the concept of civilisation according to Islamic and Western views, including focus on physical and spiritual development.

text: Pandangan Islam membina tamadun atas asas Islam sebagai al-Din, iaitu cara hidup.
text_en: The Islamic view builds civilisation on the basis of Islam as al-Din, a way of life.

text: Pandangan Islam menekankan keseimbangan perkembangan lahiriah dan rohaniah berdasarkan al-Quran dan Hadis.
text_en: The Islamic view emphasizes a balance between physical and spiritual development based on the Quran and Hadith.

text: Ibn Khaldun memperkenalkan istilah umran dan hadharah dalam Muqaddimah.
text_en: Ibn Khaldun introduced the terms umran and hadharah in Muqaddimah.

text: Hadharah merangkumi akidah, undang-undang, akhlak, falsafah, dan budaya, manakala madaniyyah merujuk kepada aspek kebendaan.
text_en: Hadharah covers faith, law, morals, philosophy, and culture, while madaniyyah refers to material aspects.

text: Pandangan Barat lebih menekankan pembangunan lahiriah, kebendaan, sains, teknologi, ekonomi, dan pembandaran.
text_en: The Western view places more emphasis on physical and material development, science, technology, economics, and urbanization.

text: Beliau memperkenalkan konsep umran dan hadharah serta menilai perkembangan masyarakat dan tamadun.
text_en: He introduced the concepts of umran and hadharah and assessed the development of society and civilisation.

text: Beliau mendefinisikan tamadun sebagai sistem yang memperkasakan politik, ekonomi, sosial, dan seni.
text_en: He defined civilisation as a system that strengthens politics, economy, society, and the arts.

text: Apakah asas utama konsep tamadun menurut pandangan Islam? / What is the main foundation of the concept of civilisation in the Islamic view?
choice_a: Islam sebagai al-Din / Islam as al-Din
choice_b: Pembangunan fizikal semata-mata / Physical development only
choice_c: Pencapaian sains dan teknologi / Scientific and technological achievement
choice_d: Sistem perdagangan bebas / Free trade system
answer: Islam sebagai al-Din / Islam as al-Din

text: Tokoh sejarawan Barat yang mendefinisikan tamadun sebagai sistem yang memperkasakan politik, ekonomi, sosial, dan seni ialah... / The Western historian who defined civilisation as a system empowering politics, economy, society, and arts is...
choice_a: E.H. Carr
choice_b: Arnold J. Toynbee
choice_c: Herodotus
choice_d: Gordon Childe
answer: Arnold J. Toynbee

text: Nyatakan satu perbezaan utama antara pandangan Islam dan pandangan Barat. / State one main difference between Islamic and Western views.
answer: Pandangan Islam menekankan keseimbangan lahiriah dan rohaniah, manakala pandangan Barat lebih menekankan pembangunan lahiriah dan kebendaan. / The Islamic view emphasizes balance between physical and spiritual development, while the Western view emphasizes physical and material development.

text: Topik ini menerangkan ciri-ciri tamadun awal dunia seperti pertanian, perdagangan, sistem pemerintahan, pembentukan bandar, pengkhususan pekerjaan, teknologi, organisasi sosial, agama, tulisan, dan kesenian.
text_en: This topic explains the characteristics of early world civilisations such as agriculture, trade, government systems, urban formation, job specialization, technology, social organisation, religion, writing, and art.

text: Pertanian dan perdagangan menjadi asas perkembangan tamadun awal.
text_en: Agriculture and trade became the foundation of early civilisations.

text: Sistem pemerintahan berkembang daripada pendeta kepada raja dan undang-undang.
text_en: Government systems evolved from priests to kings and laws.

text: Kampung berkembang menjadi bandar yang tersusun dengan kubu dan kuil.
text_en: Villages developed into organized cities with forts and temples.

text: Pekerjaan menjadi lebih khusus seperti pemungut cukai, askar, jurutera, petani, dan tukang.
text_en: Jobs became more specialized such as tax collectors, soldiers, engineers, farmers, and artisans.

text: Teknologi seperti monumen, metalurgi, roda, dan bajak memajukan tamadun awal.
text_en: Technologies such as monuments, metallurgy, wheels, and plows advanced early civilisations.

text: Organisasi sosial menjadi lebih hierarki dengan golongan pemerintah, tukang, petani, dan hamba.
text_en: Social organization became more hierarchical with rulers, artisans, farmers, and slaves.

text: Agama dan kepercayaan memainkan peranan penting dalam kehidupan masyarakat.
text_en: Religion and belief played an important role in people's lives.

text: Tulisan seperti piktograf dan kuneiform membantu menyimpan rekod.
text_en: Writing systems such as pictographs and cuneiform helped preserve records.

text: Kesenian dan kesusasteraan memperkukuh identiti dan budaya masyarakat.
text_en: Art and literature strengthened identity and culture.

text: Dalam organisasi sosial tamadun awal, golongan manakah berada di lapisan paling bawah? / In the social organization of early civilisations, which group was at the lowest tier?
choice_a: Petani / Farmers
choice_b: Artisans / Artisans
choice_c: Hamba / Slaves
choice_d: Pedagang / Merchants
answer: Hamba / Slaves

text: Apakah contoh sistem tulisan awal yang menggunakan piktograf dalam Tamadun Mesopotamia? / What is an example of an early writing system using pictographs in Mesopotamian civilisation?
choice_a: Hieroglif / Hieroglyphs
choice_b: Kuneiform / Cuneiform
choice_c: Abjad / Alphabet
choice_d: Sanskrit / Sanskrit
answer: Kuneiform / Cuneiform

text: Senaraikan dua ciri utama perkembangan tamadun awal dunia. / List two main characteristics of the development of early world civilisations.
answer: Pertanian dan perdagangan, serta pembentukan bandar dan sistem pemerintahan. / Agriculture and trade, as well as city formation and government systems.

text: Topik ini menerangkan empat tamadun awal dunia yang berkembang di lembah sungai serta kepentingan sungai kepada masyarakatnya.
text_en: This topic explains four early world civilisations that developed in river valleys and the importance of rivers to their communities.

text: Tamadun Mesopotamia berkembang di antara Sungai Tigris dan Sungai Euphrates.
text_en: Mesopotamian Civilisation developed between the Tigris and Euphrates Rivers.

text: Tamadun Mesir Purba berkembang di Lembah Sungai Nil.
text_en: Ancient Egyptian Civilisation developed in the Nile River Valley.

text: Tamadun Indus berkembang di Lembah Sungai Indus.
text_en: Indus Civilisation developed in the Indus River Valley.

text: Tamadun Huang He berkembang di Lembah Sungai Huang He atau Sungai Kuning.
text_en: Huang He Civilisation developed in the Huang He, or Yellow River, Valley.

text: Sungai membekalkan air untuk pertanian dan kegunaan harian, di samping menjadi laluan perhubungan dan pengangkutan.
text_en: Rivers supplied water for agriculture and daily use, as well as routes for communication and transportation.

text: Antara yang berikut, sungai manakah yang berkaitan dengan Tamadun Mesopotamia? / Which of the following rivers is associated with the Mesopotamian Civilisation?
choice_a: Sungai Nil / Nile River
choice_b: Sungai Indus / Indus River
choice_c: Sungai Tigris / Tigris River
choice_d: Sungai Huang He / Huang He River
answer: Sungai Tigris / Tigris River

text: Apakah fungsi utama sungai kepada masyarakat tamadun awal? / What was the main function of rivers to early civilisations?
choice_a: Pembinaan kubu tentera / Building military forts
choice_b: Sumber air dan pengangkutan / Water source and transportation
choice_c: Pusat perlombongan emas / Gold mining centres
choice_d: Tempat rekreasi / Recreation spots
answer: Sumber air dan pengangkutan / Water source and transportation

text: Tamadun Mesir Purba terletak di kawasan lembah sungai yang dikenali sebagai: / Ancient Egyptian Civilisation was located in which river valley?
choice_a: Lembah Sungai Indus / Indus River Valley
choice_b: Lembah Sungai Nil / Nile River Valley
choice_c: Lembah Sungai Yangtze / Yangtze River Valley
choice_d: Lembah Bulan Sabit / Crescent Valley
answer: Lembah Sungai Nil / Nile River Valley

text: Nyatakan dua kepentingan sungai kepada pembentukan tamadun awal dunia. / State two importances of rivers in the formation of early world civilisations.
answer: Sungai membekalkan air untuk aktiviti pertanian dan kegunaan harian, serta menjadi laluan perhubungan dan pengangkutan. / Rivers provide water for agricultural activities and daily use, and serve as communication and transportation routes.

text: Topik ini menerangkan perkembangan Tamadun Mesopotamia, Mesir Purba, Indus dan Huang He.
text_en: This topic explains the development of the Mesopotamian, Ancient Egyptian, Indus, and Huang He Civilisations.

text: Tamadun Mesopotamia bermula di Sumeria, kawasan Bulan Sabit Subur, dan terkenal dengan negara-kota seperti Ur serta zigurat.
text_en: Mesopotamian Civilisation began in Sumer in the Fertile Crescent and was known for city-states such as Ur and ziggurats.

text: Tamadun Mesir Purba dikenali sebagai Hadiah Sungai Nil dan melalui zaman Kerajaan Purba, Pertengahan, dan Baru.
text_en: Ancient Egyptian Civilisation was known as the Gift of the Nile and passed through the Old, Middle, and New Kingdom periods.

text: Tamadun Indus mempunyai bandar terancang Mohenjo-Daro dan Harappa dengan sistem perpaipan dan pembetungan yang canggih.
text_en: Indus Civilisation had the planned cities of Mohenjo-Daro and Harappa, with sophisticated plumbing and sewerage systems.

text: Tamadun Huang He berkembang di utara China melalui kerajaan Xia, Shang, dan Zhou.
text_en: Huang He Civilisation developed in northern China through the Xia, Shang, and Zhou dynasties.

text: Anyang menjadi salah satu pusat penting dalam perkembangan Tamadun Huang He.
text_en: Anyang was one important centre in the development of Huang He Civilisation.

text: Mengapakah Mesir Purba digelar 'Hadiah Sungai Nil' oleh Herodotus? / Why was Ancient Egypt called 'The Gift of the Nile' by Herodotus?
choice_a: Membekalkan batu liat untuk bangunan / Supplied clay bricks for buildings
choice_b: Banjir tahunan membawa lumpur hitam yang subur / Annual flooding brought fertile black silt
choice_c: Menjadi kawasan pelancongan utama / Became a primary tourism hub
choice_d: Membekalkan hasil laut utama dunia / Provided the world's main seafood supply
answer: Banjir tahunan membawa lumpur hitam yang subur / Annual flooding brought fertile black silt

text: Bandar terancang Mohenjo-Daro dan Harappa dibina dalam tamadun manakah? / The planned cities of Mohenjo-Daro and Harappa were built in which civilisation?
choice_a: Tamadun Mesopotamia / Mesopotamian Civilisation
choice_b: Tamadun Mesir Purba / Ancient Egyptian Civilisation
choice_c: Tamadun Indus / Indus Civilisation
choice_d: Tamadun Huang He / Huang He Civilisation
answer: Tamadun Indus / Indus Civilisation

text: Apakah tempat ibadat berbentuk piramid yang dibina di pusat bandar Tamadun Mesopotamia? / What pyramid-shaped place of worship was built in the city center of the Mesopotamian Civilisation?
choice_a: Sfinks / Sphinx
choice_b: Piramid / Pyramid
choice_c: Zigurat / Ziggurat
choice_d: Candi / Temple
answer: Zigurat / Ziggurat

text: Jelaskan keistimewaan perancangan bandar dalam Tamadun Indus. / Explain the special features of city planning in the Indus Civilisation.
answer: Kota dibina mengikut grid yang tepat, mempunyai jalan raya yang lebar, dinding bata tebal untuk mengelakkan banjir, serta sistem perpaipan dan pembetungan yang canggih. / Cities were built on a precise grid pattern, with wide roads, thick brick walls to prevent flooding, and sophisticated piping and sewerage systems.

text: Topik ini membandingkan sumbangan tamadun awal dalam pemerintahan, ekonomi, teknologi, kesenian dan binaan.
text_en: This topic compares contributions of early civilisations in government, economy, technology, arts, and architecture.

text: Tamadun Mesopotamia menyumbang Kod Hammurabi, tulisan kuneiform, roda, bajak, sauh, dan sistem nombor berasaskan 60.
text_en: Mesopotamian Civilisation contributed the Code of Hammurabi, cuneiform writing, the wheel, plough, anchor, and a base-60 number system.

text: Tamadun Mesir Purba diperintah oleh Firaun dan menghasilkan papirus, kalendar 365 hari, perubatan, piramid, serta Sfinks.
text_en: Ancient Egypt was ruled by Pharaohs and produced papyrus, a 365-day calendar, medicine, pyramids, and the Sphinx.

text: Tamadun Indus mempunyai pemerintahan oleh golongan pendeta, perkembangan pertanian dan perdagangan, serta tembikar dan ukiran batu.
text_en: Indus Civilisation was governed by priests and developed agriculture, trade, pottery, and stone carvings.

text: Tamadun Huang He memperkenalkan konsep Mandat dari Syurga, kompas magnetik, benang sutera, dan puisi.
text_en: Huang He Civilisation introduced the Mandate of Heaven, magnetic compass, silk thread, and poetry.

text: Sumbangan tamadun awal menjadi asas perkembangan pentadbiran, ekonomi, teknologi, dan kebudayaan dunia.
text_en: Early civilisations' contributions formed foundations for world administration, economy, technology, and culture.

text: Apakah sumbangan penting Raja Hammurabi dari Tamadun Mesopotamia? / What was the major contribution of King Hammurabi of the Mesopotamian Civilisation?
choice_a: Pembinaan Piramid / Construction of Pyramids
choice_b: Kod Undang-undang Hammurabi / Code of Hammurabi
choice_c: Penciptaan Kompas Magnetik / Invention of the magnetic compass
choice_d: Penemuan kertas papirus / Invention of papyrus paper
answer: Kod Undang-undang Hammurabi / Code of Hammurabi

text: Sistem tulisan terawal yang dicipta oleh masyarakat Mesir Purba dikenali sebagai: / The earliest writing system created by the Ancient Egyptians is known as:
choice_a: Kuneiform / Cuneiform
choice_b: Piktograf / Pictograph
choice_c: Hieroglif / Hieroglyphs
choice_d: Ideogram / Ideogram
answer: Hieroglif / Hieroglyphs

text: Apakah inovasi teknologi yang dihasilkan oleh masyarakat Tamadun Huang He? / Which technological innovation was produced by the Huang He Civilisation?
choice_a: Roda dan sauh / Wheel and anchor
choice_b: Kompas magnetik dan benang sutera / Magnetic compass and silk thread
choice_c: Terusan air dan zigurat / Water canals and ziggurats
choice_d: Ubat mumi dan papirus / Mummification medicine and papyrus
answer: Kompas magnetik dan benang sutera / Magnetic compass and silk thread

text: Terangkan dua sumbangan Tamadun Mesopotamia dalam bidang teknologi dan matematik. / Explain two contributions of the Mesopotamian Civilisation in technology and mathematics.
answer: Tamadun Mesopotamia mencipta roda, bajak, dan sauh untuk pengangkutan serta pertanian, dan memperkenalkan sistem nombor berasaskan 60 yang membahagikan masa kepada 60 minit dan bulatan kepada 360 darjah. / Mesopotamian Civilisation invented the wheel, plough, and anchor for transport and agriculture, and introduced a base-60 number system that divides time into 60 minutes and circles into 360 degrees.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Topik ini menerangkan lokasi, polis dan ciri utama Tamadun Yunani.
text_en: This topic explains the location, polis, and main features of Greek Civilisation.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tamadun Yunani berkembang di Semenanjung Greece dan pulau-pulau di Laut Aegean serta Laut Mediterranean antara 1000 SM hingga 800 SM.
text_en: Greek Civilisation developed on the Greek Peninsula and islands in the Aegean and Mediterranean Seas between 1000 BC and 800 BC.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Negara-kota Yunani dikenali sebagai polis dan terdiri daripada bandar utama, bandar kecil, serta kawasan kampung.
text_en: Greek city-states were known as polis and consisted of a main town, small towns, and countryside villages.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Acropolis ialah pusat komuniti berkubu di lokasi strategik, manakala Agora ialah kawasan lapang untuk pertemuan dan pasar awam.
text_en: The Acropolis was a fortified community centre in a strategic location, while the Agora was an open meeting and marketplace area.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Athens mempunyai penduduk paling ramai, Sparta paling luas, dan Corinth juga merupakan polis terkenal.
text_en: Athens had the largest population, Sparta was the largest in area, and Corinth was also a famous polis.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Apakah kawasan lapang di dalam polis yang berfungsi sebagai tempat pertemuan dan pasar awam? / What is the open area in a polis that functioned as a meeting place and public market?
choice_a: Acropolis
choice_b: Agora
choice_c: Colosseum
choice_d: Parthenon
answer: Agora

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Antara polis berikut, yang manakah mempunyai bilangan penduduk yang paling ramai dalam Tamadun Yunani? / Among the following polis, which had the largest population in Greek Civilisation?
choice_a: Sparta
choice_b: Corinth
choice_c: Athens
choice_d: Olympia
answer: Athens

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Mengapakah Acropolis dianggap sebagai lokasi yang paling strategik di dalam sesebuah polis? / Why was the Acropolis considered the most strategic location in a polis?
choice_a: Ia merupakan pusat utama aktiviti pertanian / It was the main center for agricultural activities
choice_b: Ia dilengkapi kemudahan pengangkutan moden / It was equipped with modern transportation facilities
choice_c: Ia menyediakan perlindungan, pusat pentadbiran, dan tempat ibadat / It provided protection, administration centers, and places of worship
choice_d: Ia merupakan tempat tinggal utama bagi golongan hamba / It was the main residence for slaves
answer: Ia menyediakan perlindungan, pusat pentadbiran, dan tempat ibadat / It provided protection, administration centers, and places of worship

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Jelaskan tiga komponen utama yang membentuk sesebuah polis dalam Tamadun Yunani. / Explain the three main components that formed a polis in Greek Civilisation.
answer: Polis terdiri daripada bandar utama, bandar kecil, dan kawasan kampung. Acropolis menjadi pusat pentadbiran dan kubu pertahanan, manakala Agora berfungsi sebagai pasar dan tempat perjumpaan awam. / A polis consisted of a main town, small towns, and countryside villages. The Acropolis was an administrative centre and defensive fortress, while the Agora served as a marketplace and public gathering space.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Topik ini menerangkan perkembangan sistem pemerintahan Athens dan Sparta.
text_en: This topic explains the development of government systems in Athens and Sparta.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Athens melalui sistem Monarki, Oligarki, Aristokrasi, Tirani, dan Demokrasi.
text_en: Athens experienced Monarchy, Oligarchy, Aristocracy, Tyranny, and Democracy.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Demokrasi Athens melibatkan Dewan Perhimpunan, Majlis 500, Majistret, dan Juri.
text_en: Athenian democracy involved the Assembly, Council of 500, Magistrates, and Juries.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Pericles memantapkan demokrasi dengan menekankan kuasa rakyat.
text_en: Pericles strengthened democracy by emphasizing the power of citizens.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Sparta mengamalkan monarki terhad yang dipimpin dua raja serta menekankan disiplin ketenteraan dan latihan fizikal.
text_en: Sparta practised a limited monarchy led by two kings and emphasized military discipline and physical training.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Apakah urutan perkembangan sistem pemerintahan di Athens sebelum mencapai sistem demokrasi? / What was the sequence of governance system changes in Athens before reaching democracy?
choice_a: Monarki → Oligarki → Aristokrasi → Tirani → Demokrasi / Monarchy → Oligarchy → Aristocracy → Tyranny → Democracy
choice_b: Monarki → Aristokrasi → Oligarki → Tirani → Demokrasi / Monarchy → Aristocracy → Oligarchy → Tyranny → Democracy
choice_c: Oligarki → Monarki → Tirani → Aristokrasi → Demokrasi / Oligarchy → Monarchy → Tyranny → Aristocracy → Democracy
choice_d: Tirani → Oligarki → Aristokrasi → Monarki → Demokrasi / Tyranny → Oligarchy → Aristocracy → Monarchy → Democracy
answer: Monarki → Oligarki → Aristokrasi → Tirani → Demokrasi / Monarchy → Oligarchy → Aristocracy → Tyranny → Democracy

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Apakah fungsi utama Majlis (Majlis 500) dalam sistem pentadbiran Athens? / What was the main function of the Council (Council of 500) in the Athenian administrative system?
choice_a: Memutuskan hukuman bagi kes mahkamah / Deciding verdicts in court cases
choice_b: Mengendalikan urusan dan melaksanakan keputusan Dewan Perhimpunan / Managing affairs and implementing decisions of the Assembly
choice_c: Memimpin pasukan tentera dalam peperangan / Leading military forces in war
choice_d: Melantik raja untuk mengetuai pentadbiran / Appointing kings to lead the administration
answer: Mengendalikan urusan dan melaksanakan keputusan Dewan Perhimpunan / Managing affairs and implementing decisions of the Assembly

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Mengapakah Sparta mengamalkan sistem pemerintahan yang dianggotai oleh dua orang raja? / Why did Sparta practice a system of governance led by two kings?
choice_a: Mengelakkan salah seorang raja bertindak kejam / To prevent one king from acting tyrannically or cruelly
choice_b: Memastikan latihan ketenteraan berjalan pantas / To ensure military training proceeded quickly
choice_c: Mengasingkan urusan agama dan pentadbiran / To separate religious and administrative affairs
choice_d: Membolehkan kaum wanita menjadi raja / To allow women to become rulers
answer: Mengelakkan salah seorang raja bertindak kejam / To prevent one king from acting tyrannically or cruelly

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Nyatakan perbezaan utama antara penekanan masyarakat di Athens dan Sparta. / State the main difference between the focus of society in Athens and Sparta.
answer: Athens menekankan kebebasan, hak warganegara, pemikiran terbuka, dan kebudayaan melalui demokrasi. Sparta pula menekankan disiplin ketenteraan, latihan fizikal, dan kesetiaan kepada negara-kota. / Athens emphasized freedom, citizens' rights, open-minded thinking, and culture through democracy. Sparta emphasized military discipline, physical training, and loyalty to the city-state.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Topik ini menerangkan lokasi, zaman perkembangan, Pax Romana dan struktur masyarakat Tamadun Rom.
text_en: This topic explains the location, historical eras, Pax Romana, and social structure of Roman Civilisation.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tamadun Rom terletak di Lembah Latium berhampiran Sungai Tiber.
text_en: Roman Civilisation was located in the Latium Valley near the Tiber River.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tiga zaman utama Rom ialah Zaman Beraja, Zaman Republik, dan Zaman Empayar.
text_en: The three main Roman eras were the Monarchy, Republic, and Empire eras.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Pax Romana berlangsung dari 27 SM hingga 180 M dan membawa keamanan selama 200 tahun di Asia, Afrika, dan Eropah.
text_en: Pax Romana lasted from 27 BC to AD 180 and brought 200 years of peace across Asia, Africa, and Europe.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Masyarakat Rom terdiri daripada Patrician, Plebian seperti petani, artisan dan peniaga, serta hamba.
text_en: Roman society consisted of Patricians, Plebeians such as farmers, artisans, and traders, and slaves.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Apakah faktor geografi yang menyumbang kepada perkembangan awal Tamadun Rom di Lembah Latium? / What geographical factor contributed to the early development of Roman Civilisation in the Latium Valley?
choice_a: Kawasan tanah tinggi yang sejuk / Cold highland areas
choice_b: Tanahnya subur dan berhampiran Sungai Tiber / Fertile land near the Tiber River
choice_c: Terpencil daripada laluan perdagangan / Isolated from trade routes
choice_d: Dikelilingi padang pasir yang luas / Surrounded by vast deserts
answer: Tanahnya subur dan berhampiran Sungai Tiber / Fertile land near the Tiber River

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Apakah yang dimaksudkan dengan istilah Pax Romana? / What is meant by the term Pax Romana?
choice_a: Sistem undang-undang bertulis Rom / Written Roman legal system
choice_b: Era peperangan besar-besaran empayar Rom / Era of major Roman imperial wars
choice_c: Keamanan Rom selama 200 tahun dalam empayar / 200 years of Roman peace within the empire
choice_d: Perjanjian perdagangan antara Rom dan Yunani / Trade agreement between Rome and Greece
answer: Keamanan Rom selama 200 tahun dalam empayar / 200 years of Roman peace within the empire

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Golongan Plebian dalam masyarakat Rom terdiri daripada... / The Plebeians in Roman society consisted of...
choice_a: Raja dan kerabat diraja / Kings and royal family members
choice_b: Golongan atasan dan bangsawan / Upper class and nobles
choice_c: Petani, artisan, dan peniaga / Farmers, artisans, and traders
choice_d: Jeneral tentera sahaja / Military generals only
answer: Petani, artisan, dan peniaga / Farmers, artisans, and traders

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Nyatakan tiga zaman utama dalam lipatan sejarah perkembangan Tamadun Rom. / State the three main eras in the historical development of Roman Civilisation.
answer: Zaman Beraja (753–509 SM), Zaman Republik (509–27 SM), dan Zaman Empayar (27 SM–476 M). / The Monarchy Era (753–509 BC), Republic Era (509–27 BC), and Empire Era (27 BC–AD 476).

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Topik ini menerangkan ciri dan kegunaan binaan utama Tamadun Rom.
text_en: This topic explains the features and uses of major Roman architectural works.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Seni bina Rom terkenal dengan ketahanan, saiz besar, nilai estetika, kubah, arca, dan penggunaan simen pozzolana.
text_en: Roman architecture was known for durability, large scale, aesthetic value, domes, arches, and the use of pozzolana concrete.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Marco Vitruvius ialah arkitek Rom terkenal yang mengarang buku On Architecture.
text_en: Marco Vitruvius was a famous Roman architect who wrote On Architecture.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Colosseum digunakan untuk pertandingan gladiator dan boleh memuatkan kira-kira 50,000 orang, manakala Pantheon ialah tempat penyembahan dewa-dewi.
text_en: The Colosseum hosted gladiator contests and seated about 50,000 people, while the Pantheon was a temple for worshipping gods.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Akueduk membekalkan air ke bandar dan tempat mandi, jalan raya berlapis digunakan untuk tentera dan pengangkutan, manakala tembok mempertahankan empayar.
text_en: Aqueducts supplied water to cities and baths, layered roads supported military movement and transport, and walls defended the empire.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Apakah bahan campuran pozzolana yang digunakan oleh orang Rom untuk membina bangunan yang kukuh? / What is the pozzolana mixture used by Romans to build strong structures?
choice_a: Pasir, lumpur, dan jerami / Sand, mud, and straw
choice_b: Kapur, air, dan abu gunung berapi / Lime, water, and volcanic ash
choice_c: Tanah liat, minyak, dan batu kapur / Clay, oil, and limestone
choice_d: Simen, kayu, dan besi / Cement, wood, and iron
answer: Kapur, air, dan abu gunung berapi / Lime, water, and volcanic ash

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Binaan Akueduk dalam Tamadun Rom dibina khas untuk tujuan apa? / What specific purpose was the Aqueduct built for in Roman Civilisation?
choice_a: Tempat perlawanan pahlawan gladiator / Venue for gladiator combat games
choice_b: Tembok sempadan pertahanan tentera / Military border defense wall
choice_c: Membekalkan air bersih secara sistematik / Systematically supplying clean water
choice_d: Laluan kereta kuda antarabangsa / International chariot route
answer: Membekalkan air bersih secara sistematik / Systematically supplying clean water

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Mengapakah Jalan Raya Rom dibina secara berlapis-lapis menggunakan batu besar, kelikir, dan konkrit? / Why were Roman roads constructed in layers using large stones, gravel, and concrete?
choice_a: Sebagai hiasan keindahan bandar / As decorations for city aesthetics
choice_b: Supaya kuat dan tahan menahan beban pasukan tentera / To make them strong and durable for military loads
choice_c: Menghalang pertumbuhan pokok di sekelilingnya / To prevent tree growth around them
choice_d: Memudahkan aktiviti pertanian dijalankan / To facilitate agricultural activities
answer: Supaya kuat dan tahan menahan beban pasukan tentera / To make them strong and durable for military loads

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Jelaskan kegunaan Colosseum dan Pantheon dalam Tamadun Rom. / Explain the uses of the Colosseum and Pantheon in Roman Civilisation.
answer: Colosseum digunakan untuk pertandingan gladiator dan persembahan bersaiz besar, manakala Pantheon ialah tempat penyembahan dewa-dewi Rom. / The Colosseum was used for gladiatorial contests and large public spectacles, while the Pantheon was a place for worshipping Roman gods and goddesses.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Topik ini menerangkan perluasan kuasa secara fizikal dan keagamaan dalam Tamadun India.
text_en: This topic explains physical and religious expansion of power in Indian Civilisation.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Perluasan kuasa ialah usaha kerajaan atau raja untuk menguasai dan memperluas pengaruh di sesebuah kawasan.
text_en: Expansion of power is the effort of a kingdom or ruler to control and expand influence in a region.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Faktor perluasan kuasa termasuk kekuatan ketenteraan, dasar pemerintahan, sumber manusia, diplomasi keagamaan, dan kewangan.
text_en: Factors of expansion include military strength, government policy, human resources, religious diplomacy, and finance.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Dinasti Nanda, Maurya dan Gupta memperluas kuasa secara fizikal; Pataliputra menjadi pusat pemerintahan utama.
text_en: The Nanda, Maurya, and Gupta Dynasties expanded physically; Pataliputra was a main administrative centre.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Selepas Perang Kalinga, Maharaja Asoka menyebarkan agama Buddha melalui Tiang Asoka dan misi ke beberapa wilayah.
text_en: After the Kalinga War, Emperor Asoka spread Buddhism through the Pillars of Asoka and missions to several regions.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Zaman Gupta dikenali sebagai zaman keemasan agama Hindu, dan Raja Samudragupta digelar Kaviraja.
text_en: The Gupta Period was known as the golden age of Hinduism, and King Samudragupta was called Kaviraja.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Apakah faktor yang membolehkan Dinasti Nanda, Maurya, dan Gupta membentuk empayar yang luas di India? / What factor enabled the Nanda, Maurya, and Gupta dynasties to form vast empires in India?
choice_a: Perdagangan maritim / Maritime trade
choice_b: Kekuatan ketenteraan dan dasar pemerintah / Military strength and ruler's policy
choice_c: Pembinaan Tembok Besar / Construction of the Great Wall
choice_d: Pengenalan sistem peperiksaan / Introduction of the examination system
answer: Kekuatan ketenteraan dan dasar pemerintah / Military strength and ruler's policy

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Mengapakah Maharaja Asoka menghentikan perluasan kuasa secara fizikal selepas Perang Kalinga? / Why did Emperor Asoka stop physical expansion after the Kalinga War?
choice_a: Kehabisan kewangan dalam perbendaharaan / Depletion of treasury funds
choice_b: Kesedaran akibat kehilangan nyawa dan kemusnahan yang besar / Awareness due to massive loss of lives and destruction
choice_c: Kehilangan sokongan daripada tentera kavalri / Loss of support from the cavalry army
choice_d: Serangan daripada empayar asing / Attacks from foreign empires
answer: Kesedaran akibat kehilangan nyawa dan kemusnahan yang besar / Awareness due to massive loss of lives and destruction

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Tokoh manakah dalam Dinasti Gupta yang meminati puisi keagamaan sehingga digelar Kaviraja? / Which figure in the Gupta Dynasty earned the title Kaviraja?
choice_a: Chandragupta I
choice_b: Asoka
choice_c: Raja Samudragupta
choice_d: Bindusara
answer: Raja Samudragupta

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Jelaskan perbezaan antara perluasan kuasa secara fizikal dengan perluasan kuasa secara keagamaan dalam Tamadun India. / Explain the difference between physical expansion and religious expansion in Indian Civilisation.
answer: Perluasan fizikal bergantung pada kekuatan tentera dan penaklukan wilayah, manakala perluasan keagamaan merentas sempadan tanpa tentera dengan menyebarkan nilai agama, kemanusiaan dan kedamaian. / Physical expansion relied on military power and territorial conquest, while religious expansion crossed borders without military force by spreading religious values, humanity, and peace.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Topik ini menerangkan perkembangan dinasti Qin dan Han, pendidikan, serta peperiksaan perkhidmatan awam Tamadun China.
text_en: This topic explains the Qin and Han Dynasties, education, and civil service examinations in Chinese Civilisation.
