chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Tamadun China bermula di Lembah Sungai Huang He.
text_en: Chinese Civilisation began in the Huang He River Valley.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Maharaja Shi Huangdi daripada Dinasti Qin menyatukan China, menyeragamkan tulisan serta unit timbang dan sukat, dan membina Tembok Besar.
text_en: Emperor Shi Huangdi of the Qin Dynasty unified China, standardized writing, weights and measures, and built the Great Wall.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Dinasti Han diasaskan oleh Liu Bang; zaman Maharaja Han Wu Di menyaksikan pembukaan Laluan Sutera dan pelaksanaan peperiksaan awam.
text_en: The Han Dynasty was founded by Liu Bang; Emperor Han Wu Di's reign saw the opening of the Silk Road and civil service examinations.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Pendidikan merangkumi peringkat rendah, menengah dan tinggi serta berasaskan teks suci dan ajaran Konfusianisme.
text_en: Education included primary, secondary, and higher levels and was based on sacred texts and Confucian teachings.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Peperiksaan perkhidmatan awam terdiri daripada Xiucai, Juren dan Jinshi; ia ketat, kompetitif, dan terbuka kepada lelaki tanpa mengira latar belakang.
text_en: Civil service examinations consisted of Xiucai, Juren, and Jinshi; they were strict, competitive, and open to males regardless of background.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Apakah sumbangan utama Maharaja Shi Huangdi dalam sejarah Tamadun China? / What was the main contribution of Emperor Shi Huangdi in Chinese Civilisation?
choice_a: Mengembangkan ajaran Buddha ke luar negara / Spreading Buddhism abroad
choice_b: Menyatukan China dan menyeragamkan sistem tulisan serta unit timbang sukat / Unifying China and standardizing the writing system and weights and measures
choice_c: Membangunkan sistem peperiksaan awam pertama / Developing the first civil service exam system
choice_d: Membina kapal perdagangan maritim utama / Building major maritime trading vessels
answer: Menyatukan China dan menyeragamkan sistem tulisan serta unit timbang sukat / Unifying China and standardizing the writing system and weights and measures

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Apakah matlamat utama seseorang individu menduduki peperiksaan perkhidmatan awam dalam Tamadun China? / What was the primary goal for an individual taking the civil service examination in Chinese Civilisation?
choice_a: Menjadi pahlawan perang / Becoming a war hero
choice_b: Meningkatkan taraf sosial dan menjadi pegawai kerajaan / Elevating social status and becoming a government official
choice_c: Mendapat lesen untuk berniaga di Laluan Sutera / Obtaining a license to trade along the Silk Road
choice_d: Diberi jawatan sebagai maharaja baharu / Being granted the position of a new emperor
answer: Meningkatkan taraf sosial dan menjadi pegawai kerajaan / Elevating social status and becoming a government official

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Peperiksaan perkhidmatan awam tahap ketiga, iaitu Jinshi, dijalankan di lokasi manakah? / Where was the third level of the civil service examination, Jinshi, conducted?
choice_a: Peringkat daerah / District level
choice_b: Ibu kota daerah / Provincial capital
choice_c: Ibu kota kerajaan / Imperial capital
choice_d: Di dalam tokong Konfusius / Inside Confucian temples
answer: Ibu kota kerajaan / Imperial capital

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Nyatakan tiga ciri utama sistem peperiksaan perkhidmatan awam yang dilaksanakan dalam Tamadun China. / State three main characteristics of the civil service examination system in Chinese Civilisation.
answer: Peperiksaan sangat kompetitif dan dikawal ketat untuk mengelakkan penipuan, terbuka kepada semua lelaki tanpa mengira latar belakang, dan berteraskan ajaran Konfusianisme. / The examinations were highly competitive and strictly controlled to prevent cheating, open to all males regardless of background, and centred on Confucian teachings.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Topik ini membincangkan masyarakat Arab sebelum Islam, termasuk kehidupan padang pasir, agama, adat, dan kehidupan seharian.
text_en: This topic discusses Arab society before Islam, including desert life, religion, customs, and daily life.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Masyarakat Arab hidup dalam persekitaran padang pasir dengan gaya hidup nomad dan kampung.
text_en: Arab society lived in a desert environment with nomadic and village lifestyles.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Mereka mengamalkan pelbagai kepercayaan, termasuk penyembahan berhala dan tradisi lisan.
text_en: They practiced various beliefs, including idol worship and oral traditions.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Adat dan kehidupan seharian menekankan nilai kekeluargaan, maruah, dan perdagangan.
text_en: Their customs and daily life emphasized family, honor, and trade.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Kebudayaan mereka dipengaruhi oleh iklim padang pasir dan hubungan dengan suku-suku lain.
text_en: Their culture was shaped by the desert climate and relations with other tribes.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Keadaan masyarakat ini menyediakan latar untuk kemunculan Islam.
text_en: These conditions provided the background for the emergence of Islam.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Bagaimanakah iklim padang pasir mempengaruhi kehidupan masyarakat Arab sebelum Islam? / How did the desert climate affect the life of Arab society before Islam?
choice_a: Menentukan gaya hidup nomad dan perdagangan jarak jauh. / It determined a nomadic lifestyle and long-distance trade.
choice_b: Menjadikan mereka hidup di bandar besar. / It made them live in large cities.
choice_c: Membuat mereka bergantung kepada pertanian moden. / It made them depend on modern agriculture.
choice_d: Membolehkan mereka hidup di dalam hutan. / It allowed them to live in forests.
answer: Menentukan gaya hidup nomad dan perdagangan jarak jauh. / It determined a nomadic lifestyle and long-distance trade.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Apakah salah satu ciri masyarakat Arab sebelum Islam? / What was one characteristic of Arab society before Islam?
choice_a: Hidup secara nomad dan di kampung. / Living nomadically and in villages.
choice_b: Menetap di bandar metropolitan sahaja. / Living only in metropolitan cities.
choice_c: Bergantung sepenuhnya pada mesin dan teknologi moden. / Depending entirely on machines and modern technology.
choice_d: Menggunakan kereta api sebagai pengangkutan utama. / Using trains as the main transport.
answer: Hidup secara nomad dan di kampung. / Living nomadically and in villages.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Mengapakah adat dan nilai kekeluargaan penting dalam masyarakat Arab sebelum Islam? / Why were customs and family values important in pre-Islamic Arab society?
choice_a: Kerana mereka membantu menyatukan suku dan masyarakat. / Because they helped unite tribes and communities.
choice_b: Kerana mereka menghalang perdagangan. / Because they prevented trade.
choice_c: Kerana mereka menjadikan orang hidup bersendirian. / Because they made people live alone.
choice_d: Kerana mereka menghapuskan semua undang-undang. / Because they abolished all laws.
answer: Kerana mereka membantu menyatukan suku dan masyarakat. / Because they helped unite tribes and communities.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Nyatakan satu faktor yang membentuk budaya masyarakat Arab sebelum Islam. / State one factor that shaped pre-Islamic Arab culture.
answer: Persekitaran padang pasir dan hubungan antara suku membentuk budaya mereka. / The desert environment and inter-tribal relations shaped their culture.

text: Topik ini menerangkan kemunculan Islam dan perkembangan tamadun Islam melalui zaman Khalifah dan kerajaan besar.
text_en: This topic explains the emergence of Islam and the development of Islamic civilization through the eras of caliphs and great empires.

text: Islam mula berkembang di Jazirah Arab dan bertapak semasa era Khulafa ar-Rashidin.
text_en: Islam began to grow in the Arabian Peninsula and took root during the Rashidun Caliphate.

text: Abu Bakar al-Siddiq mengukuhkan umat Islam selepas kewafatan Nabi Muhammad SAW.
text_en: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq strengthened the Muslim community after the Prophet Muhammad SAW passed away.

text: Zaman Umar dan Uthman menyaksikan perkembangan wilayah melalui penaklukan dan pentadbiran.
text_en: The eras of Umar and Uthman saw territorial expansion through conquest and administration.

text: Daulah Umaiyah meluaskan Islam hingga ke Sepanyol, manakala Abbasiyah berkembang hingga Transoxania.
text_en: The Umayyad Caliphate expanded Islam to Spain, while the Abbasid Caliphate reached Transoxania.

text: Tamadun Islam mula membina pusat intelektual dan ilmu pengetahuan.
text_en: Islamic civilization began to establish intellectual centers and scholarship.

text: Zaman Khalifah manakah yang terkenal kerana perluasan Islam hingga ke Sepanyol? / Which caliphate era is known for expanding Islam to Spain?
choice_a: Daulah Umaiyah. / The Umayyad Caliphate.
choice_b: Daulah Abbasiyah. / The Abbasid Caliphate.
choice_c: Zaman Uthman bin Affan. / The era of Uthman bin Affan.
choice_d: Zaman Khalifah Abu Bakar. / The era of Caliph Abu Bakr.
answer: Daulah Umaiyah. / The Umayyad Caliphate.

text: Siapakah khalifah yang memperluaskan wilayah Islam dari Sepanyol ke Asia Tengah? / Which caliph extended Islamic rule from Spain to Central Asia?
choice_a: Daulah Umaiyah. / The Umayyad Caliphate.
choice_b: Daulah Abbasiyah. / The Abbasid Caliphate.
choice_c: Daulah Fatimiyah. / The Fatimid Caliphate.
choice_d: Daulah Mughal. / The Mughal Empire.
answer: Daulah Umaiyah. / The Umayyad Caliphate.

text: Apakah peranan pusat intelektual semasa perkembangan tamadun Islam? / What was the role of intellectual centers during the development of Islamic civilization?
choice_a: Menyediakan tempat belajar, sains, dan kajian. / Providing places for learning, science, and research.
choice_b: Menjadi pasar untuk barang mewah sahaja. / Being markets for luxury goods only.
choice_c: Menghalang komunikasi antara pelajar. / Preventing communication among students.
choice_d: Hanya digunakan sebagai benteng tentera. / Used only as military fortresses.
answer: Menyediakan tempat belajar, sains, dan kajian. / Providing places for learning, science, and research.

text: Nyatakan satu sumbangan tamadun Islam dalam bidang ilmu pengetahuan. / State one contribution of Islamic civilization in the field of knowledge.
answer: Pusat intelektual seperti Baghdad membantu mengembangkan sains dan falsafah. / Intellectual centers like Baghdad helped develop science and philosophy.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Topik ini menyorot peranan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai pemimpin negara, masyarakat dan tentera dalam sejarah Islam awal.
text_en: This topic highlights the role of Prophet Muhammad SAW as a state, community, and military leader in early Islamic history.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Nabi Muhammad SAW diiktiraf sebagai pemimpin rohani, politik dan sosial bagi umat Islam.
text_en: Prophet Muhammad SAW is recognized as the spiritual, political, and social leader of Muslims.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Beliau mengurus negeri Madinah dan menyusun masyarakat berbilang kaum.
text_en: He managed the state of Medina and organized a plural society.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Prinsip kepimpinannya termasuk keadilan, toleransi dan kerjasama antara rakyat.
text_en: His leadership principles included justice, tolerance, and cooperation among people.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Sebagai pemimpin tentera, beliau memimpin peristiwa penting seperti Badar, Uhud dan Khandaq.
text_en: As a military leader, he led important events like Badr, Uhud, and the Trench.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Kepimpinan beliau membantu membentuk asas negara Islam yang adil dan teratur.
text_en: His leadership helped build the foundations of a just and orderly Islamic state.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Sebagai pemimpin utama, Nabi Muhammad SAW memimpin masyarakat Islam dari segi agama, politik dan pertahanan.
text_en: As the main leader, Prophet Muhammad SAW led the Muslim community in religion, politics, and defense.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Apakah salah satu peristiwa penting yang dipimpin oleh Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai ketua tentera? / Which major event was led by Prophet Muhammad SAW as a military commander?
choice_a: Perang Badar. / The Battle of Badr.
choice_b: Perjanjian Hudaibiyah. / The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah.
choice_c: Pembukaan Baghdad. / The conquest of Baghdad.
choice_d: Perang Uhud. / The Battle of Uhud.
answer: Perang Badar. / The Battle of Badr.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Apakah prinsip utama kepimpinan Nabi Muhammad SAW dalam masyarakat Madinah? / What was a main leadership principle of Prophet Muhammad SAW in Madinah society?
choice_a: Keadilan, toleransi, dan kerjasama. / Justice, tolerance, and cooperation.
choice_b: Kekerasan tanpa perbincangan. / Violence without discussion.
choice_c: Pengasingan suku-suku. / Segregation of tribes.
choice_d: Mengharamkan perdagangan. / Banning trade.
answer: Keadilan, toleransi, dan kerjasama. / Justice, tolerance, and cooperation.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Apakah maksud Nabi Muhammad SAW mengurus negeri Madinah? / What did it mean for Prophet Muhammad SAW to manage the state of Madinah?
choice_a: Menjadi pemimpin politik, sosial dan rohani. / Being a political, social, and spiritual leader.
choice_b: Hanya menjalankan upacara keagamaan sahaja. / Only performing religious rituals.
choice_c: Menjadi pedagang pasar. / Being a market trader.
choice_d: Hanya tinggal di rumah sahaja. / Only staying at home.
answer: Menjadi pemimpin politik, sosial dan rohani. / Being a political, social, and spiritual leader.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Terangkan satu cara Nabi Muhammad SAW menyusun masyarakat berbilang kaum di Madinah. / Explain one way Prophet Muhammad SAW organized the multi-ethnic society in Madinah.
answer: Beliau membina perjanjian dan undang-undang bersama untuk memastikan keamanan antara suku dan agama. / He created agreements and joint laws to ensure peace among tribes and religions.

text: Topik ini membincangkan sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam bidang politik, ekonomi, sosial dan ilmu pengetahuan.
text_en: This topic discusses the contributions of Islamic civilization in politics, economy, society, and knowledge.

text: Tamadun Islam menyumbang dalam politik melalui sistem khalifah dan undang-undang Islam.
text_en: Islamic civilization contributed politically through the caliphate system and Islamic law.

text: Ekonomi Islam berkembang melalui perdagangan, pertanian dan sistem kewangan berlandaskan zakat.
text_en: Islamic economy developed through trade, agriculture, and finance based on zakat.

text: Aspek sosial termasuk perpaduan, pendidikan dan kemajuan kebudayaan dalam masyarakat Islam.
text_en: Social aspects included unity, education, and cultural advancement in Muslim societies.

text: Pusat intelektual seperti Baghdad menjadi pusat ilmu, sains dan falsafah.
text_en: Intellectual centers such as Baghdad became hubs for knowledge, science, and philosophy.

text: Ilmuan Islam seperti Al-Khwarizmi dan Ibnu Sina memberikan sumbangan penting kepada dunia.
text_en: Islamic scholars like Al-Khwarizmi and Ibn Sina made important contributions to the world.

text: Beliau dikenali sebagai bapa algebra dan menyumbang pada perkembangan matematik dalam tamadun Islam.
text_en: He is known as the father of algebra and contributed to the development of mathematics in Islamic civilization.

text: Apakah sumbangan Al-Khwarizmi kepada dunia ilmu? / What was Al-Khwarizmi's contribution to the world of knowledge?
choice_a: Algebra. / Algebra.
choice_b: Fizik moden. / Modern physics.
choice_c: Penulisan novel. / Novel writing.
choice_d: Pertanian. / Agriculture.
answer: Algebra. / Algebra.

text: Dalam bidang apakah Al-Khwarizmi paling terkenal? / In which field is Al-Khwarizmi most famous?
choice_a: Matematik dan algebra. / Mathematics and algebra.
choice_b: Seni bina. / Architecture.
choice_c: Perubatan. / Medicine.
choice_d: Seni muzik. / Music.
answer: Matematik dan algebra. / Mathematics and algebra.

text: Mengapa ilmuan Islam penting dalam tamadun Islam? / Why were Islamic scholars important in Islamic civilization?
choice_a: Kerana mereka mengembangkan ilmu dan teknologi. / Because they developed knowledge and technology.
choice_b: Kerana mereka membina istana sahaja. / Because they only built palaces.
choice_c: Kerana mereka melarang pembelajaran. / Because they banned learning.
choice_d: Kerana mereka mengurus hanya perdagangan. / Because they only managed trade.
answer: Kerana mereka mengembangkan ilmu dan teknologi. / Because they developed knowledge and technology.

text: Nyatakan satu contoh sumbangan tamadun Islam kepada dunia hari ini. / State one example of an Islamic civilization contribution to the world today.
answer: Al-Khwarizmi memperkenalkan algebra yang masih digunakan dalam matematik moden. / Al-Khwarizmi introduced algebra that is still used in modern mathematics.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Topik ini menerangkan ciri seni bina Islam dan bagaimana ia memberi inspirasi kepada pembinaan masjid, istana, dan ruang awam.
text_en: This topic explains the features of Islamic architecture and how it inspired the construction of mosques, palaces, and public spaces.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Seni bina Islam terkenal dengan kubah, menara, lengkungan dan corak geometri.
text_en: Islamic architecture is known for domes, minarets, arches, and geometric patterns.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Bangunan seperti masjid dan istana mencerminkan nilai keagamaan dan estetika.
text_en: Buildings such as mosques and palaces reflect religious values and aesthetics.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Reka bentuk seni bina Islam sering menggunakan taman, air mancur dan kaligrafi.
text_en: Islamic architectural design often uses gardens, fountains, and calligraphy.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Cordoba dan Baghdad adalah contoh bandar dengan bangunan seni bina Islam yang megah.
text_en: Cordoba and Baghdad are examples of cities with magnificent Islamic architecture.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Sumbangan seni bina Islam terus memberi inspirasi kepada seni bina di seluruh dunia.
text_en: The contribution of Islamic architecture continues to inspire architecture worldwide.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Apakah salah satu ciri seni bina Islam yang biasa dilihat? / What is one common feature of Islamic architecture?
choice_a: Kubah. / Dome.
choice_b: Menara jam. / Clock tower.
choice_c: Menara radio. / Radio tower.
choice_d: Stesen kereta api. / Train station.
answer: Kubah. / Dome.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Apakah elemen geometri yang sering digunakan dalam seni bina Islam? / What geometric element is often used in Islamic architecture?
choice_a: Corak geometri. / Geometric patterns.
choice_b: Lukisan potret. / Portrait painting.
choice_c: Grafiti moden. / Modern graffiti.
choice_d: Reka bentuk kartun. / Cartoon design.
answer: Corak geometri. / Geometric patterns.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Apakah salah satu fungsi taman dan air mancur dalam seni bina Islam? / What is one function of gardens and fountains in Islamic architecture?
choice_a: Mewujudkan suasana damai dan sejuk. / Creating a peaceful and cool environment.
choice_b: Menjadi tempat pasaran. / Being a market place.
choice_c: Menjadi bilik kelas. / Being a classroom.
choice_d: Menyimpan peralatan tentera. / Storing military equipment.
answer: Mewujudkan suasana damai dan sejuk. / Creating a peaceful and cool environment.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Jelaskan satu cara seni bina Islam menunjukkan nilai keagamaan. / Explain one way Islamic architecture shows religious values.
answer: Bangunan seperti masjid menggunakan kubah, kaligrafi, dan ruang yang tenang untuk menunjukkan nilai keagamaan. / Buildings like mosques use domes, calligraphy, and calm spaces to show religious values.
